mapper.select: select ROW_NUMBER() over() rn, B.Finprod_id finprodId, B.Finprod_Market_id finprodMarketId, B.Finprod_abbr finprodAbbr, A.cash_id cashId, A.ACCR_DATE accrDate, ACCR_STR_DATE accrStrDate, ACCR_END_DATE accrEndDate, VAL_DATE valDate, case when (select count(1) from (select bookset_id finprod_id, happen_date trade_date from BOK_CLAWBACK_INFO_DETAIL union all select finprod_id, trade_date from trd_fin_product_deal_total where (is_cancel is null or is_cancel = 'N') and p_trade_id is null and not exists (select 1 from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL b where b.P_TRADE_ID = trd_fin_product_deal_total.Totle_trade_id)) D where D.finprod_id = B.finprod_id and D.trade_date = A.accr_date) > 0 then '01' else '02' end supplementStatus from fin_float_accrual_sche A, fin_product B, fin_cash_info C where A.cash_id = C.cash_id and c.finprod_id = B.finprod_id and B.finprod_id = #{finprodId,jdbcType = VARCHAR} and C.Cash_Type_1 = #{CASH_TYPE_1_06, jdbcType = VARCHAR} order by ACCR_STR_DATE
